crossRefs.note: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”
translations.bsb: Hate evil and love good; establish justice in the gate. Perhaps the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”
translations.kjv: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
translations.asv: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish justice in the gate: it may be that Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
